name: Kiss
overview: The act of kissing in Scripture reveals a range of deep human emotions and spiritual significance. From Isaac’s affectionate blessing of his son (Genesis 27:26-27) to the heartfelt reconciliation between Esau and Jacob (Genesis 33:4), kissing expresses love, blessing, and restoration. It also marks significant moments of devotion and farewell, as seen when Laban kisses his children before departing (Genesis 31:55). These instances highlight the kiss as a meaningful gesture that conveys both personal affection and sacred connection.
